dimensions.assessment: Affects Medicare beneficiaries with end stage renal disease who receive home dialysis, as well as the physicians furnishing remote monitoring services.
dimensions.evidence: individuals with end stage renal disease under the Medicare program

dimensions.assessment: Expands coverage for specific remote monitoring services, altering payment rules under Medicare for eligible patients.
dimensions.evidence: payment for remote physiologic monitoring services furnished by a physician on or after January 1, 2028... shall be made on the basis described in section 1848

dimensions.assessment: Changes Medicare payment structures for remote physiologic monitoring for a specific subset of patients, with exact aggregate federal spending impacts not detailed in the text.
dimensions.evidence: payment for remote physiologic monitoring services furnished by a physician... shall be made on the basis described in section 1848

dimensions.assessment: Makes a targeted statutory amendment to title XVIII of the Social Security Act regarding home dialysis remote monitoring payment rules.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1881(b)(3) of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395rr(b)(3)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Provides an ongoing, permanent statutory change to Medicare payment rules taking effect on a specific future date.

missing_information: Congressional Budget Office cost estimates for the expansion of remote monitoring services.
Exact number of Medicare beneficiaries who will utilize the home dialysis remote monitoring services.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Social Security Act to expand remote physiologic monitoring services under Medicare for individuals with end stage renal disease receiving home dialysis, starting January 1, 2028.
